dedupe_keys.name: thenergy database of solar and wind power plants at mining sites

description: An online list of solar and wind power plants built at or for mines. The THEnergy page presents a database of renewable plants linked to mining operations, with entries such as the Mount Cattlin lithium mine in Western Australia, each giving the mine, the owner, the technology and capacity where known. It is free to browse on the website. Coverage is global mines with renewable plants. Caveats: the page read does not state a licence, a download format, a count of entries or an update date, and it is maintained by a consultancy. For simulation it shows which mines rely on their own solar or wind generation, which changes their exposure to grid outages and fuel supply disruption. A related catalogue record is the Parker Bay mining equipment database.
